id: title:Gilbert09:explain a play reporting api outage instead of a raw 500

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion retryability checks for transient Google API failures, potentially reducing ingestion failures and manual intervention.
review.reason: Adds a 500 Server Error entry and a test asserting it remains retryable, distinguishing transient vendor API failures from permanent errors. This could help warehouse ingestion distinguish transient vendor API failures from permanent errors, potentially allowing automatic retries without manual intervention.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether this error is transient and whether the retry mechanism is implemented and effective; the code establishes the classification and test but does not independently verify the outcome of the retry or the complete implementation of the retry mechanism.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
